name: @red-cup-engineering/solitaire-561-group
description: solitaire.561.group — one rules engine, variant rules as data: Klondike, FreeCell, Spider (1/2/4-suit), Yukon, Forty Thieves, Golf, TriPeaks, and Pyramid all read from the same declarative VariantSpec, with deterministic seeded deals, a solver-certified FreeCell deal generator, and a move-log that doubles as undo/redo and replay source.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mts web/test/*.test.mts; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node check-mts.mjs "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in web/js/*.mjs web/server.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
